definitions.explanation: a person who officiates a sports event, enforcing rules and making judgments on plays

examples.japanese: {審判員|しんぱんいん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ファウル→ファウル：06584_fauru⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}った→取る：00565_toru⟧。
{審判員|しんぱんいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}する→抗議する：26923_kougisuru⟧。
⟦プロ→プロ：03871_puro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{試合|しあい}→試合：01601_shiai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{審判員|しんぱんいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧。
examples.english: Serve as a referee in a professional match.

notes:
A slightly formal word for a sports official; in conversation and commentary ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧ is more common.

TYPES:
- ⟦{主審|しゅしん}→主審：09268_shushin⟧: the head referee or umpire
- ⟦{副審|ふくしん}→副審：09269_fukushin⟧: an assistant referee
- ⟦{線審|せんしん}→線審：08629_senshin⟧: a line judge
- {球審|きゅうしん}: the home plate umpire (baseball)
- {塁審|るいしん}: a base umpire (baseball)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{審判|しんぱん}→審判：03331_shinpan⟧: the everyday word for the official and for the judging itself
- レフェリー: referee, used in soccer, rugby and boxing
- アンパイア: umpire, mainly baseball

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {審判員|しんぱんいん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{判定|はんてい}→判定：09767_hantei⟧: the official's call
- {審判員|しんぱんいん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{抗議|こうぎ}する→抗議する：26923_kougisuru⟧: to protest to the official
- {審判員|しんぱんいん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{務|つと}める→務める：10446_tsutomeru⟧: to serve as an official
